A '''ship''' was used to escape [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]], [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], and [[Clan Secura]] heir [[Nat Secura]] after a [[Mission to Kintan|mission]] there.
